Title: Generally Available: Playwright Workspaces in Azure App Testing

Body.Content:
Playwright Workspaces capability in Azure App Testing is now generally available. Playwright Workspaces enables you to run end-to-end tests with high parallelization across multiple browsers and devices, to validate the functionality of your applications at scale.
With this release, Azure App Testing brings together Playwright Workspaces and Azure Load Testing into a unified experience. Developers and QA teams can now run large-scale functional and performance tests using tools such as Playwright, JMeter, and Locust - all from a single, integrated hub in the Azure Portal.
Learn more.
